[SWS_DM_02095] Provision of target address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the target address (TA) of the diagnostic server to which the
diagnostic request was sent within metaInfo using the Key kTA in all the subsequently
called ara::diag interfaces.
